scenario.name: fleet_update_rollout
scenario.description: Completed governed production rollout of pkg-mdr-triage-agent version 2.4.0 to policy-eligible MSSP and MDR tenant scopes through package signing, immutable registration, canary activation, limited activation, broad activation, monitoring gates, exclusion enforcement, and closeout while retaining version 2.3.4 as the known-good rollback target.

authorization_context.reason_new_policy_decision_not_required: The package, manifest, rollout scope, risk classification, conditions, and decision validity remained unchanged throughout the rollout.
